name: AEvent
description_en:
AEvent orchestrates webinar registration, messaging and follow-up around delivery systems such as Zoom, GoToWebinar and its own AStream. It uses a timeline to coordinate reminders and actions before, during and after an event. This makes it an automation layer for a webinar funnel rather than simply a video meeting room.

Behavioral follow-up can distinguish no-shows, partial viewers and replay watchers, but data and delivery conditions matter. Replay activity tracking is explicitly tied to AStream, and automatic like-live Zoom or GoToWebinar delivery belongs to higher plans. Marketing promises of doubled attendance or higher sales were not independently verified.
description_zh:
AEvent 围绕 Zoom、GoToWebinar 和自有 AStream 编排网络研讨会的报名、消息和后续联系，通过时间线协调会前、会中与会后动作。因此，它主要是研讨会流程的自动化层，而不只是视频会议室。

按行为跟进可区分未出席、部分观看与回放观看，但依赖数据和交付条件。回放行为追踪明确依赖 AStream，Zoom 或 GoToWebinar 的自动类直播属于更高套餐。翻倍出席或提高销售等宣传未经过独立验证。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate email, SMS and other connected-channel actions around an event.
core_features.explanation_zh: 围绕活动协调邮件、短信及其他已连接渠道动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Route by attendance and engagement; AStream is required for the described replay tracking.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按出席和互动分流，所述回放追踪需要 AStream。

en: Send different webinar follow-ups for attendees and no-shows.
zh: 分别跟进研讨会出席者和未出席者。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Connect the delivery platform, CRM and hosted pages, then test registration-to-follow-up with a disposable contact.
steps.zh: 连接交付平台、CRM 和托管页面，用测试联系人核对报名至跟进。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription tier with campaign/action quotas and automated-delivery server hours.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Displayed monthly plans: Basic $95, Pro $295, Advanced $495, Enterprise $995, Unlimited $1,995. Limits differ by campaigns, actions and server hours. Yearly discount and first-month-free promotion require checkout confirmation; external platform/message charges were not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 页面月度套餐：Basic $95、Pro $295、Advanced $495、Enterprise $995、Unlimited $1,995，campaign、动作与服务端小时上限不同。年付折扣和首月免费促销需结账确认，外部平台及消息费未确定。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Design the event timeline and its data inputs
sections.title_zh: 设计活动时间线与数据输入
sections.en: AEvent sequences registration, reminders, behavior triggers and follow-up through connected systems. An illustrative product demo might send a confirmation, a timed reminder and a different follow-up for attendees versus no-shows. The behavior guide says users host their own registration, confirmation and replay pages and embed AEvent, so page-builder access and webinar/CRM credentials remain setup dependencies. Test the complete attendee route, including time zone and cancellation changes.
sections.zh: AEvent 通过连接的系统编排报名、提醒、行为触发和跟进。例如产品演示可发送确认、定时提醒，并分别跟进出席与未出席者。行为指南说明报名、确认及回放页面由用户自行托管并嵌入 AEvent，因此需要页面工具权限和研讨会/CRM 凭据。应测试完整参与者路径，包括时区及取消变更。

sections.title_en: Verify which player supplies engagement events
sections.title_zh: 确认哪个播放器提供行为事件
sections.en: The vendor describes attendance, viewing percentage and CTA events, but qualifies replay tracking with use of AStream. A connector name alone does not prove that an external replay host supplies the same events. Define how an absent or delayed event should affect follow-up. No tracking, replay delivery or message retry was executed here, and we do not adopt advertised revenue or attendance gains as measured outcomes.
sections.zh: 厂商介绍出席、观看比例及 CTA 事件，但明确回放追踪需使用 AStream。连接器名称不能证明外部回放平台提供相同事件。应定义事件缺失或延迟时如何跟进。本文未执行追踪、回放交付或消息重试，也不把宣传收入与出席提升当成测量结果。

sections.title_en: Count actions, campaigns and server hours separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算动作、活动编排和服务端小时
sections.en: Basic lists $95/month with ten campaigns and 10,000 actions. Pro lists $295/month with twenty campaigns, 20,000 actions and sixty server automation hours, including Zoom/GoToWebinar like-live automation. Sending a message, applying a tag or firing a webhook are examples of actions; one registrant can therefore cause several. Advanced, Enterprise and Unlimited increase different limits, so the plan name alone does not describe every resource.
sections.zh: Basic 列每月 $95、10 个 campaign 和 10,000 次动作；Pro 每月 $295、20 个 campaign、20,000 次动作及 60 个服务端自动化小时，包含 Zoom/GoToWebinar 类直播自动化。发消息、加标签、调用 webhook 都是动作例子，因此一名报名者可能产生多次动作。Advanced、Enterprise、Unlimited 提高不同上限，不能只看套餐名判断所有资源。

sections.title_en: Check the promotion and external-channel costs
sections.title_zh: 核对促销与外部渠道成本
sections.en: The page advertises a special first month free and a yearly discount, not an established permanently free plan. Before buying, confirm the selected billing basis, action reset, server-hour overage and separate Zoom, phone, SMS or WhatsApp charges. AEvent is a candidate when webinar sequencing and segmentation are the main work; a simple one-off meeting may not need this layer. No source-code license, self-hosted package or contractual recovery guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: 页面宣传首月免费促销和年付折扣，不能视为持续免费套餐。购买前确认账期、动作重置、服务端小时超额，以及 Zoom、电话、短信或 WhatsApp 的独立费用。当研讨会编排与分组是主要工作时可以考虑 AEvent，简单单次会议未必需要这一层。本次未确认源码许可、自托管服务包或合同恢复保证。

research_gaps: No webinar, AStream replay, messaging, behavior trigger or failure recovery was tested.
Currency, promotion/renewal, quota reset/overage, external messaging charges, retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
